exposure: good knowledge on danger signs of obstetric
good awareness of birth preparedness and complications readiness plan
getting married after the age of 18 years
faced at least one complication during pregnancy
travel time to health facility (<30 min)
not practised traditional malpractice during labour
lack of adequate delivery material in the health facility
cohort: The study included 422 mothers who had delivered within 1 year prior to the study at Gilgelbelles town, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: Only 39.6% of mothers delivered at a health facility, with sociodemographic, reproductive, and knowledge-related factors, along with cultural and resource availability issues, significantly associated with institutional delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from 1 February 2020 to 2 March 2020, focusing on births that occurred within 1 year prior to the study.
